description: This file appears to be a shell script used for firmware upgrade and identification purposes in a Linux-based embedded device. It contains functions to identify firmware images, verify their validity, extract specific data, and perform upgrades based on the image type, especially tailored for specific hardware models and vendors.

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a specified file at a specified offset and returns the hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a specified file at a specified offset and interprets them as a little-endian long integer.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Determines the expected firmware image identifier based on the device model read from /tmp/sysinfo/model.

methods.name: bcm47xx_identify
methods.description: Identifies the type of firmware image (trx, chk, cybertan, lxl, lxlold, unknown) based on magic numbers and header data.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity and compatibility of a firmware image file according to its identified type, and verifies its integrity.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_chk_cmd
methods.description: Outputs the command to extract the TRX image from a chk firmware image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_cybertan_cmd
methods.description: Outputs the command to extract the TRX image from a CyberTAN firmware image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxl_cmd
methods.description: Outputs the command to extract the TRX image from a Luxul (lxl) firmware image using the header length.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxlold_cmd
methods.description: Outputs the command to extract the TRX image from an older Luxul firmware image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process based on the identified image type, constructing the appropriate extraction command and invoking default_do_upgrade.
